name: DirectChat – Floating Chat Button
author: Nitish Verma

sections.description:
🔥 DirectChat – The Best WhatsApp Chat Plugin for WordPress & WooCommerce.

Let your website visitors contact you instantly via WhatsApp or WhatsApp Business with a single click. DirectChat bridges the gap between you and your customers, helping you boost sales, provide support, and capture leads effortlessly.

Unlike outdated plugins, DirectChat features a stunning Glassmorphism UI, smooth animations, and is built for Performance (Zero jQuery).

👉 See Live Demo | Get PRO Version

WATCH: How to Setup DirectChat in 2 Minutes 👇

🚀 Free Features – Powerful & Lightweight

📱 Seamless Connectivity
* Mobile: Automatically opens the WhatsApp Mobile App.
* Desktop: Directs users to WhatsApp Web (web.whatsapp.com) or Desktop App.

🎨 Modern Design & Customization
* Glassmorphism UI: Stand out with a premium, frosted-glass look.
* Pulse Animation: Grabs visitor attention instantly without being annoying.
* Custom Positions: Place the button on the Left or Right side of the screen.
* Custom Call-to-Action: Add tooltips like “Need Help?” or “Chat with us”.

⚡ Performance Focused
* No jQuery: Written in pure Vanilla JS. Doesn’t slow down your site.
* Lightweight: Less than 10KB loaded on the frontend.
* Device Targeting: Show/Hide on Mobile or Desktop specifically.

🕵️ Smart Context
* Pre-filled Messages: Start the conversation for the user.
* Dynamic Variables: Automatically insert {SITE_TITLE} or {CURRENT_URL} in the message so you know exactly where the user is coming from.

💎 PRO Features – Unlock Business Growth

Upgrade to DirectChat Pro to unlock powerful features designed for Teams, Agencies, and E-commerce stores.

👥 1. Multi-Agent Support
Don’t rely on a single number. Create a team list inside the chat window.
* Add multiple agents (e.g., Sales, Support, Billing).
* Add names and designations (e.g., “John – Tech Lead”).
* Let customers choose the right person to talk to.

💬 2. Premium ChatBox Interface
Simulate a real live-chat experience.
* Instead of redirecting immediately, show a beautiful Chat Window inside your website.
* Engage users with a custom welcome message and header.
* Keeps users on your website longer.

🛍️ 3. Advanced WooCommerce Integration
Supercharge your store sales with the “Order on WhatsApp” feature.
* Product Context: Automatically adds the Product Name & URL to the WhatsApp message.
* Example: “Hi, I am interested in buying [Nike Shoes – Red].”
* Buy Button: Add a dedicated WhatsApp button below the “Add to Cart” button on single product pages.

📊 4. Analytics & Tracking
Stop guessing. Start tracking.
* Google Analytics 4 (GA4): Automatically sends events to GA4 when someone clicks the chat button.
* Measure which pages drive the most WhatsApp conversations.

🛡️ 5. GDPR Compliance
Stay compliant with EU laws.
* Show a Consent Checkbox before starting the chat.
* Ensure users agree to your terms before contacting.

👉 Upgrade to DirectChat Pro ($29)

💡 Why Choose DirectChat?

  • Easy Setup: Get started in 2 minutes. No coding required.
  • 100% Responsive: Looks perfect on iPhone, Android, iPads, and Desktops.
  • Clean Code: Follows strict WordPress coding standards.
  • Priority Support: Pro users get fast, dedicated email support.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the directchat-floating-button folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to ‘DirectChat’ in the admin menu.
  4. Enter your WhatsApp phone number with country code (e.g., 919876543210).
  5. Customize other settings as needed.
sections.faq:
How do I add my phone number?

Go to DirectChat settings in your WordPress admin panel and enter your phone number with country code (without + symbol). For example: 919876543210.

Does it support WooCommerce?

The Free version works on WooCommerce pages, but the Pro Version adds a dedicated “Order on WhatsApp” button specifically for products.

Can I add multiple numbers?

Multi-agent support is available in the Pro Version.
